tableDesign.properties.tableName.note: U:grid/data: Table Name shows the table at the selection; Enter renames it (table.rename: structured references, slicers and PivotTables follow). Checked against gridcraft (cmd/insert/table.rs table_rename).

tableDesign.properties.resize.note: U:grid/data: Resize Table opens Excel's dialog (new data range); the headers stay in their row and the new range overlaps the old one. Checked against gridcraft (cmd/extra/data.rs table_resize).

tableDesign.tools.convertToRange.note: U:grid/data: the table look stays as formatting and structured references become cell references. Checked against gridcraft (table_convert), extended with the reference conversion.

tableDesign.external.export.note: U:grid/data: hidden. Export Table to SharePoint List / Visio PivotDiagram need a SharePoint connection; gridcraft has none.

tableDesign.external.properties.note: U:grid/data: hidden. Linked-table properties need a SharePoint link; gridcraft has none.

tableDesign.external.openInBrowser.note: U:grid/data: hidden. Open in Browser needs a SharePoint link; gridcraft has none.

tableDesign.external.unlink.note: U:grid/data: hidden. Unlink needs a SharePoint link; gridcraft has none.

tableDesign.styleOptions.headerRow.note: U:grid/data: Excel's Header Row: hiding it clears the header cells and keeps the column names; showing it writes them back above the data (a row is inserted when that row holds data). gridcraft's table.headerRow toggled the filter buttons, which is the Filter Button box here.

tableDesign.styleOptions.totalRow.note: U:grid/data: checked against gridcraft (table_flag totals, write_totals); cells below move down when the row under the table holds data.

tableDesign.styles.gallery.note: U:grid/data: the 21 Light, 28 Medium and 11 Dark styles drawn as tiles from the style's header, band and line colours (gridcraft tables.rs gallery); Clear removes the style.

tableDesign.styles.gallery.new-table-sty.note: U:grid/data: hidden. gridcraft has no custom table styles (a style is one of its built-in names), so New Table Style has no engine.
